title: Peel a display module's protective film with tweezers while steadying its carrier
instruction: Use the tweezers from the stand to pull the blue protective film off the display module by its tab in the carrier's slot, while holding the loose carrier still. Lay the film on the table outside the carrier, put the tweezers back upright in the stand, and move both hands away.
context: In display module assembly, the protective film is removed from the cover glass before the module is bonded into its housing. Here the film's pull tab hangs in a narrow slot of the assembly carrier that fingers cannot enter, so it has to be lifted with tweezers while the other hand keeps the unclamped carrier from sliding or lifting. The film is then set aside and the tweezers returned to their stand.
setup: Dual-YAM station on a 1.10 x 1.30 x 0.06 m oak table, centre (0.36,0,0.7175) m, top z=0.7475 m. Arm bases (0,+/-0.305,0.75) m, left at +y, facing +x. A loose ABS carrier with glass display insert, total 250 g, occupies x=0.225..0.335, y=-0.21..0.14, z=0.7475..0.7645 m. Its base is 3 mm thick; display is 72 x 135 mm, x=0.244..0.316, y=-0.190..-0.055, glass top z=0.7625. Side rails are 21 mm wide; front support flange starts y=-0.049. A 12 x 6 mm slot at x=0.274..0.286, y=-0.055..-0.049 has a 14 mm depth above the base. Blue PE protective film is 66 x 130 mm at x=0.247..0.313, y=-0.185..-0.055. Its first 10 mm next to the tab (y=-0.065..-0.055) is a non-adhesive starter zone; the other 120 mm is stuck to the glass. The custom folded starter tab has an 8 x 10 x 1 mm hanging face centred at (0.28,-0.052,0.7580) m. Two 1.2 x 3 x 1 mm side connections leave a 5.6 mm central entry notch and 2.5 mm rear clearance. A 15 g stainless-steel tweezer tool, 120 mm long, has 2.4 x 0.8 mm tips and rests open 8 mm, pointing down in an ABS stand centred (0.36,-0.24). Stand floor is 30 x 34 x 3 mm; four 3 mm thick walls rise 20 mm above z=0.7505. The stand is fixed. No calibration coupon is present. Exact component bounds and the fixed starting layout are in fixture_geometry.py and tool_geometry.py.
scoring: Any carrier excursion beyond 30 mm horizontally, 5 mm vertically or 10 degrees yaw/tilt, or film seam separation beyond 3 mm, makes the trial score 0. Consecutive peeled adhesive length, from the starter zone: <30 mm: 0; >=30 mm: 0.25; >=60 mm: 0.5; >=90 mm: 0.75. Full credit requires all 120 mm of adhesive detached; every film piece at least 2 mm outside the carrier, within 30 mm above the tabletop, with table support; tool tip centre within 4.5 mm horizontally (inside the stand cavity) and 5 mm vertically of the stand target, tool tilt <=5 degrees and tip opening 6-10 mm. Film and tool must move below 10 mm/s and 0.5 rad/s, and both TCPs must be at least 80 mm from every task object, for 1 second.
reset_notes: Use fresh protective film and the specified folded/notched starter tab for each physical trial. Place the carrier flat and the open tool upright in the stand. Simulator reset restores all poses and adhesive joints; use object_jitter=0 and seed 0.
fidelity: PhysX at 240 Hz. Film: 13 rigid 10 mm strips (the first non-adhesive) and a rigid folded tab, 1 mm collision thickness; the tab is simulated at 3 g for stable tweezer contact. Peel-front springs (0.03 N m/rad) release above 60 degrees at 20 Hz, not fitted to measured adhesion. Tweezer halves slide on a 150 N/m spring, approximating flexure; contact alone grasps the tool. Carrier friction 0.4. No stretching, wrinkles, tearing, scratches or ESD. Tab and carrier are benchmark-designed.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (2,400 steps, step limit); scripted demo: 1.0 (1,298 steps).
